cr_data.provenance: (Alfred Stieglitz, New York, NY); George Herbert Engelhard, New York, NY, 1920s; Georgia Engelhard Cromwell, New York, NY, bequest, 1945; Parke-Bernet Galleries, Inc., New York, NY, sale no. 1599, lot no. 58, 11 May 1955; (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); The artist, 1955; (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Private collection, New York, NY, 1960; (Andrew Crispo Gallery, Inc., New York, NY); Gerald Peters Gallery, Santa Fe, New Mexico, and Elaine Horwitch Gallery, Scottsdale, Arizona; Private collection, New York, NY, 1978 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Infor. from O'Keeffe, April 1946: Sold to George Herbert Engelhard. See gallery photograph 12–c. Now owned by his daughter, Georgia Engelhard. Stored at An American Place." Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert." "I think it was the best of that set and it will probably sell again." (Georgia O'Keeffe to Edith Halpert, 22 May 1955, Archive of American Art). Pictured in 1924 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 24. Reproduced and titled *Calla Lily* in *The Arts* (April 1924); reproduced and titled *Calla Lily* in *Arts and Decoration* (April 1926). (Source: Lynes, 1999)
